sections.title: Transnational Crime
sections.description: This course examines the complex and evolving landscape of transnational crime, which generates billions of dollars annually and operates across international borders. Far from the glamorized portrayals in popular media, the reality of transnational organized crime is rooted in fluid, global networks that thrive on illegal markets for drugs, firearms, human trafficking, counterfeit goods, and more. In this course students will explore the multifaceted nature of these crimes, their impact on global security, and their role in undermining economic, social, and political systems worldwide.
